title: Tea shop has three different kinds of request
brief:
Client: Cloud Kettle Tea; contact robin@example.com.
Design one A3 drinks menu with the supplied copy.
Supply one print PDF and one JPEG of the approved menu.
Two revision rounds cover text size, spacing and colour adjustments to the menu.
First proof is due 20 October; final files are due 26 October.
Out of scope: loyalty cards, packaging and new illustrations.
message: Morning Pip, please increase the prices text size on the menu. Could you also design a two-sided loyalty card? And can the menu feel more welcoming? Thanks for taking a look.
